games.name: 60 seconds until the end of the world
📉 Cart ride to save canny cat [PONZI SCHEMES!]
games.desc:
a remake for crtscc is in the works, stay tuned

Core mechanics inspired by "Cart ride around a 75kw diesel generator". it should be in similar experiences go check it out too

The evil 🐈‍⬛ uncanny cats have kidnapped 🐈 canny cat and put him at the end of a perilous cart ride. Grab a cart and go save your kitty!

Controls/Tips:

CTRL to shiftlock
LMB or DOUBLE TAP to pick up unanchored part (such as a cart)
SHIFT + WASDQE or ROTATE BUTTON + JOYSTICK to rotate currently held part

To start the game, pick up a cart and place it on the rails, then click the green button to start the cart. Make sure to look out for traps along the way! 
Remember that if your cart derails, you can jump out and drag it back into place. 

Building and electrical signals in this game can be confusing at first. Just remember that only parts which are glued together will transfer signals, and don't be afraid to ask experienced players for help. 

Have fun! 💥💥💥

games.name: Clark County
games.desc:
The County of Clark is the largest county in the State of Mayflower, home to the busiest and most populous city in the Union of Columbia; the City of Lander.

The area that is now the County of Clark was settled by colonists hailing from Pax Britannia in December of 1771 as a part of the original 14 colonies as Pax Landeria. Proceeding the end of the revolution against Pax Britannia in July of 1776 and the creation of the Union of Columbia and the State of Mayflower, the County of Clark was created as one of the four original counties of the State of Mayflower.

The current county seat for the County of Clark is the Town of Mersea. Alongside the county seat, the County of Clark is home to the state seat for the State of Mayflower; the City of Lander.

This experience is constantly developing and is prone to changes, including shutdowns and the wipe of player data.

The in-game time period is in the early 2000s.
